sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Power Crushers Licensing Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 2001
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (LICENSING) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE I OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Power Crushers (Licensing)
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 4th January, 2001]
No. Legis.1(12)/80/47, dated
4-1-2001.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North- West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Power Crushers (Licensing) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 6 of N.W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980

ORDINANCE I OF 2001
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (LICENSING) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE I OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Power Crushers (Licensing)
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 4th January, 2001]
No. Legis.1(12)/80/47, dated
4-1-2001.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North- West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 6 of
N.-W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980.--In the said Ordinance, in section 6, for
subsections (1) and (2), the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(1) There shall be charged
a fee for the grant and renewal of a licence at the following rates:--
Power Crushers
Grant of licence
Renewal of licence.
(a) Power Crushers between six
and twelve Horse Power.
Rs.10,000
Rs.7,000
(b) Power Crushers of more than
twelve Horse Power.
Rs.15,000
Rs.12,000
(c) Commercial Cane Crushers.
Rs.30,000
Rs.27,000
(2) No fee shall be charged in
respect of Ghanies and power crushers below six horse power."
